snippet.title: Michael Jackson in Brazil – The Untold Story (Spike Lee’s Vision)
snippet.description:
Spike Lee delivers a keynote in Brazil including about the making of Michael Jackson's they don't care about us. Filmed in Rio de Janeiro and Salvador Bahia, Brazil.

Spike Lee is a legend in cinema and his talk in Rio de Janeiro was electric. Watch as he discusses the importance of cinema, the creative process in filmmaking, Brazilian film and the Afro Brazilian cinema movement. Politics and the importance of creativity in storytelling are also discussed in this powerful talk. Part 1

Spike Lee in Rio de Janeiro - Part 2 https://youtu.be/BHYmFzijQHI

Spike Lee in Rio de Janeiro - Part 3 https://youtu.be/OwChWHF7L6A

Spike Lee in Rio de Janeiro - Part 4  https://youtu.be/tMW4jsnPldo

#Spike Lee #Power of Creativity #Black Filmmakers
